name: blast-engineering-ui
description: Conversation-native engineering workspace for the shaft-blast design project (DSH client plugin: the shell's own three-column AppFrame — a Project/Case/Design-Version/Thread/Artifact context sidebar, the untouched native conversation with BLAST engineering nodes in each turn tail, and an in-place artifact Preview column — plus voice as a composer input mode and a structured parameter-change gate; ships the `blast-demo` minimal-permission Agent Profile tools as an optional host row).
